source._comment: Arizona has party registration but NO single statewide by-party early-vote feed: each of the 15 county recorders publishes separately (Maricopa daily ballot-return stats + others), in different formats. az_update.py is a MULTI-COUNTY AGGREGATOR: it iterates `counties`, runs a registered per-county parser (scripts/az_update.py PARSERS[fips]) where one exists, and merges results into the statewide by-party schema. Per-county parsers are added as each county's live feed is confirmed (the routine wires them, biggest-first: Maricopa 04013, Pima 04019, Pinal 04021, Maricopa covers ~60% of AZ voters). Reads 0 for counties without a wired parser.

counties.name: Maricopa
counties.source: https://data-maricopa.opendata.arcgis.com/ (Maricopa County Elections GIS: 'Early Voting Returns' feature services)
counties._comment: recorder.maricopa.gov / elections.maricopa.gov sit behind a Cloudflare browser challenge; these public ArcGIS feature services (owner MaricopaElectionsGIS) are not. Per precinct: Requests, Returns (signature-verified), ElectionDescription, for 'the currently active election'; all voters + Republican + Democratic layers (rest -> npa). Still held the JULY 21 2026 PRIMARY as of 2026-09-23 — the parser waits until ElectionDescription contains every election_token. Also available (unused): Maricopa_County_Early_Voting_Returns_In_Hand (received, not yet verified) and Maricopa_County_Voter_Totals_By_Voting_Precinct (registration by party; empty on 2026-09-23).
